name.value: Sea to Sky Hotel and Conference Centre

description.value: The Sea to Sky Hotel is a 52-room property in Garibaldi Highlands, Squamish — a town billed as the Outdoor Recreation Capital of Canada — with the RideHub Cafe operating inside the lobby and direct access to Garibaldi Provincial Park and Alice Lake trails. The hotel explicitly caters to adventure travellers including mountain bikers, with on-demand secure equipment storage and a 24-hour front desk. Its location on the Sea to Sky corridor places it roughly 30 minutes from Whistler and within walking distance of grocery and dining options.

address.value: 40330 Tantalus Road, Garibaldi Highlands, British Columbia, Canada, V0N 1T0

Wi-Fi is confirmed via the rooms page ('Complimentary WIFI in all rooms'). Nearby grocery and evening food are confirmed by website amenity listings. OSM phone and address match the website contact footer exactly.
concerns: Minor name spelling discrepancy: OSM uses 'Conference Centre' (British) while website footer uses 'Conference Center' (American) — unlikely to affect listing but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active hotel in a premier BC cycling destination with confirmed on-demand bike storage, cycling-aware staff, and proximity to major trail networks — a clear fit for the WWC directory.
